I also got work as help at the inn, 2 coins a shift, starting tomorrow at eight. I talked with Ivana Horvat twice, mostly about the rain and the mill being slow. I bought soup twice. I didn't make it to the chandlery or the bakery, and I still don't know who runs what beyond Ivana. The rain didn't stop all day. I've got 36 coins left, a job, and a roof. Now I need to actually learn this town.

insights: Rosa Vidal is mayor now and seems to be fishing for what people need. I should stay polite but vague until I know more.
The damp is slowing the mill and people are talking about it. That could be a wedge issue if I need one.
Petar Ilić hears rumors about plot fees but won't vouch for them. The council is already on people's minds.
intentions: Ask around quietly about how the mill is doing and whether anyone blames the mayor for it.
Offer to help at the inn or chandlery to earn coins and hear more talk.
Walk the hill road and orchard to see more of the island and who lives there.

opinions.opinion: She's chatty but careful, and she's already mayor. I'll keep my distance but stay friendly.
He's a baker who hears rumors but won't commit to them. Seems honest enough.

projects.title: Find food and rest
projects.why: I need a stable place and enough to eat while I get my bearings.

projects.title: Learn the town layout
projects.why: I want to know every corner of this island so I can see what's really going on.

output.saying: Prices here change with the wind more than the weather.

self.summary: I'm a stranger here, and I mean to stay that way until I see which way the wind blows.
self.want: I want to understand who runs things and where the blame lands, so I can decide if I want a second term or not.

output.summary: I arrived this morning, paid for three nights at the inn, bought soup and bread, and walked the harbor, market, and council hall. The rain has been heavy all day. I talked with Rosa Vidal, who is mayor, and with Petar Ilić, the baker. I stayed mostly vague about my own interests. I still have 37 coins and two nights paid at the inn. I haven't done any work yet.
